title: RNA Extraction and Precipitation for PES and Polycarbonate Filters
author: Frank Ferrer-Gonzalez
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bervjd66

steps.title: Prepare Sample Tubes and Beads
steps.instruction: Prepare a low-binding 2.0 ml tube for each sample containing 400 μl of beads.

substeps.instruction: Use a mix of 200 μl 0.1 mm zirconium beads, 100 μl 0.5 mm glass beads, and 100 μl 0.5 mm zirconium beads.
If processing phytoplankton, include glass beads.
If extracting from bacteria only, replace glass beads with additional 0.5 mm zirconium beads.

steps.title: Prepare Membrane Filters
steps.instruction: Cut membrane filters using RNAse-free scissors.

steps.title: Lysis and Incubation
steps.instruction: Add lysis buffer and Proteinase K to the sample and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Add T1E1 buffer (10 mM Tris + 10 mM EDTA) with SDS 0.6% and Proteinase K 120 ng/μl.
Vortex for 10 minutes.
Incubate at room temperature (RT) for 50 minutes.
Add 964 μl of T1E1 buffer, 30 μl of 20% SDS stock, and 6 μl of proteinase K (total volume 1000 μl).

steps.title: Add RNA Standard
steps.instruction: Add an RNA standard equivalent to 0.5% of the expected yield.

steps.title: Separate Supernatant from Beads
steps.instruction: Isolate the supernatant from the beads using centrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Transfer supernatant to a new low-binding 2.0 ml microtube, ensuring no beads are transferred.
Centrifuge for 1 min at 8,000 rpm.
If beads are still present in the sample, repeat the transfer and centrifugation.

steps.title: Phenol-Chloroform Extraction
steps.instruction: Perform an initial organic extraction to remove proteins.

substeps.instruction: Add Acidic Phenol:Chloroform:Isoamyl alcohol (25:24:1) at a 1:1 volume.
Shake until emulsified (do not vortex).
Incubate the mixture on ice for 15 min.
Centrifuge at 13,400 rpm for 15 min at 4°C.
Collect the supernatant in a new 2.0 ml tube.

steps.title: Chloroform Cleanup
steps.instruction: Perform a chloroform wash to remove residual phenol.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 volume of Chloroform:Isoamyl alcohol (24:1) (or chloroform alone, though this may create foam).
Shake until emulsified.
Incubate the mixture on ice for 15 min.
Centrifuge at 13,400 rpm for 15 min at 4°C.
Collect the supernatant in a new tube.
Repeat this cleanup process (addition, incubation, and centrifugation) one more time.

steps.title: RNA Precipitation
steps.instruction: Precipitate the RNA using isopropanol and cold incubation.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 volume of isopropanol.
Mix with a 21g syringe and shear DNA by repeating the action 8-10 times.
Incubate at -20°C overnight.

steps.title: Pellet Recovery
steps.instruction: Centrifuge to pellet the RNA and remove the supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge for 30 min at 13,400 rpm at 4°C.
Carefully remove the supernatant without losing the pellet (supernatant may be transferred to a new microtube for potential pellet recovery).

steps.title: Ethanol Wash
steps.instruction: Wash the RNA pellet with ethanol to remove salts.

substeps.instruction: Add 1.0 ml 75% ethanol.
Centrifuge for 10 min at 13,400 rpm at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant carefully to avoid losing the pellet.
Repeat the ethanol addition and centrifugation step one more time.

steps.title: Drying the Pellet
steps.instruction: Perform a short spin to ensure all residual ethanol is removed.

substeps.instruction: Repeat the short spin until the pellet appears clear (a wet pellet will look white).

steps.title: Resuspension and Storage
steps.instruction: Resuspend the RNA and store or use immediately.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend in ~30 μl RNAse-free water (adjust volume based on experimental needs).
Wait 30 min to 1 hour on ice for the RNA to fully dissolve before taking a reading.
Proceed to other applications or store at -80°C.
